0232Literature and linguistics

SanskritEnv

Space · Adityahars/Sanskrit-env

Resolve structural linguistic ambiguity in Sanskrit manuscript passages across six task layers, from glossary anchoring to full manuscript sessions.

Open on Hugging FaceHow to run it

Good for

  • training on low-resource language ambiguity
  • deterministic reproducible grading

Reward

How it is scored
Exact match
Signal
Graded, 0 to 1

Deterministic graders compare answers by exact string match against pre-annotated answer tables; no LLM judge or BLEU.

How to run it

1. From the cardcopied from the publisher's own instructions

docker run --rm -p 7860:7860 sanskrit-env:local

2. Run the Space locallyevery Space is a Docker image or app you can clone

git clone https://huggingface.co/spaces/Adityahars/Sanskrit-env
cd Sanskrit-env

The Space also runs live on the Hub; open it to see the API it serves.

Framework documentation: OpenEnv. Needs: Docker.

Evidence

Baseline runs over 25 episodes per task report mean scores between 0.28 and 0.82.

As reported by the publisher. We have not reproduced it.
